findings.claim: In addGuests.handler.ts, the team permission check uses `isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...)` where `||` is intended. This reduces it to an owner-only check, so team ADMINs who are not the organizer or an attendee get FORBIDDEN even though the variable is named isTeamAdminOrOwner.

verifier.reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:46-48, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` combines `await isTeamAdmin(...)` and `await isTeamOwner(...)` with `&&` instead of `||`. Because `isTeamAdmin` matches ADMIN or OWNER while `isTeamOwner` matches only OWNER (packages/lib/server/queries/teams/index.ts:264-294), team ADMINs who are neither organizer nor attendee evaluate to false and get a FORBIDDEN error at addGuests.handler.ts:54-56.

findings.claim: The BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS check lowercases the blacklist but compares it against the raw guest email, with no toLowerCase or extractBaseEmail normalization. Blacklisted addresses therefore pass when submitted with different casing or a plus-alias.

verifier.reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:70-78, blacklistedGuestEmails lowercases entries from process.env.BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS, but line 77 checks !blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest) against the raw guest email validated only by z.string().email() in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 without toLowerCase() or extractBaseEmail(). Consequently, blacklisted addresses submitted with different casing or a plus-alias bypass the filter.

findings.claim: sendAddGuestsEmails does not respect the hideCalendarNotes setting, so hidden notes can be sent to attendees.

verifier.reason: In packages/emails/email-manager.ts:525-550, sendAddGuestsEmails passes calendarEvent unmodified to AttendeeScheduledEmail (line 542) and AttendeeAddGuestsEmail (line 544) without clearing additionalNotes when hideCalendarNotes is true, unlike sendScheduledEmails (line 119) and sendScheduledSeatsEmails (line 267). Neither template nor BaseScheduledEmail (packages/emails/src/templates/BaseScheduledEmail.tsx:82) or getAdditionalNotes (packages/lib/CalEventParser.ts:57-64) checks hideCalendarNotes, so additionalNotes can be included in attendee emails.

findings.claim: In onError, the toast message is the template string `${code}: ${t(msg)}`, which is never falsy. The unable_to_add_guests fallback is therefore never used, and users see raw 'CODE: key' strings.

verifier.reason: In apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:42-45, onError builds `message` as `` `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}` ``, which always contains `": "` and is therefore never falsy, making the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback on line 44 unreachable. Users always see raw `${code}: ...` strings, including untranslated keys such as `FORBIDDEN: you_do_not_have_permission` thrown from packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:55 (which is absent from apps/web/public/static/locales/en/common.json).

findings.claim: The new action updates by bookingId only, without seat-level scoping, so on seats events guests are added to the shared booking instead of the current seat.

verifier.reason: In apps/web/components/booking/BookingListItem.tsx:193-200,356-360, the new add_members action exposes AddGuestsDialog on all confirmed bookings passing only bookingId without seatReferenceUid or any seats guard, and packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:3-6 accepts only bookingId and guests. Consequently, packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92-106 updates prisma.booking by id: bookingId only, adding guests directly to the shared Booking.attendees on seats events without seat-level scoping.

findings.claim: The MultiEmail component reassigns its function parameter `value`.

verifier.reason: In packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx:12-14, MultiEmail destructures value in its parameter list and reassigns it on line 14 (`value = value || [];`), and the same pattern appears in packages/features/form-builder/Components.tsx:234-237. Because value is a local destructured binding, reassigning it does not mutate caller props and is purely a style/lint nit.
